app_fee.value: No application fee is stated for PhD applicants. The fees on this page are an annual doctoral contribution (EUR 3,000 tuition) for candidates not employed by the university.

fee_waiver.value: No international fee waiver is stated on the Twente Graduate School PhD pages.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated on the Twente Graduate School PhD pages or the university language page checked.

toefl_min.value: For the September 2027 intake, a TOEFL iBT taken after January 2026 needs an overall score of 5, with at least 5 on reading, listening and writing and 4.5 on speaking. Tests taken before January 2026 use the old scale, with a minimum of 100.
toefl_min.quote: Not older than two years, with an overall score of 5, and a minimum score of 5 on reading, listening and writing.

also.quote: For speaking a minimum score of 4.5 is required.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall band of 6.5 for the September 2027 intake, with at least 6.0 in each section, and the certificate must be no more than two years old.
ielts_min.quote: Not older than two years, with an overall band score of at least 6.5, and a minimum score on each section of at least 6.0.

english_waiver.value: Twente says it offers no English waivers beyond listed exceptions, which are in its English Language Tool; India is not named on the pages checked, so an Indian applicant must check the tool.
english_waiver.quote: Please consult the English Language Tool to determine whether any of the listed exceptions may apply to your situation.

also.quote: Please note that individual requests for waivers outside the stated exceptions cannot be considered, as the University of Twente does not offer English waivers.
Doctoral candidates with a non-Dutch MSc degree or qualification are admitted if they have sufficient command of the English language.

notes: Checked 2026-10-26. The official pages give no per-field PhD list: Twente Graduate School (TGS) coordinates all doctoral programmes, so program records exist only where a department or school page describes its own PhD. The English rules are the master's language page, which the TGS page says PhD candidates follow. Blocked or unavailable: https://www.utwente.nl/en/itc/education/admission/ returned 404 (Dutch-only page). Fetch budget: seven university-wide fetches (one over the brief's six, needed for the English thresholds).
